subject: Deal runway clearance / soft lock request — Vertex Analytics (late-stage)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deal runway clearance / soft lock request — Vertex Analytics (late-stage)

Team,

Vertex Analytics is now at legal + procurement and asking us to confirm capacity posture for a January POC start. They want a short soft-lock window to ensure we can hold the dedicated sizing until the signed SOW lands. Quick summary:
- Requested start: week of 2027-01-10
- POC expected 4 weeks, then production ramp (Q1) if performance checks pass
- Estimated steady-state footprint (per our sizing): 8 A100-class GPUs with 2x burst nodes for peak inference slices

Can you validate current availability for that footprint in us-west and whether we can place a short soft lock (30 days) against it? If we can't commit a hard reserve, I'd like to request an ops-side conditional hold and a fallback plan (compatible quantized variant / spot fallback). Attached: Vertex_POA_estimate_v3.xlsx and GPU_Runbook_v2.pdf for context.

Ask: Ben — inventory snapshot + recommended hold window. Marissa — ops escalation if we need to convert to a dedicated commit. Karthik — I will coordinate the mutual action plan with the prospect.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deal runway clearance / soft lock request — Vertex Analytics (late-stage)

Priyom —

Inventory snapshot (us-west region):
- Unallocated A100-equivalent capacity: 24 GPUs across 6 nodes
- Currently committed but flexible: 12 GPUs (can be reclaimed with 14-day notice)
- Spot/ephemeral pool: additional ~18 GPUs but with preemption risk

Options and recommendation:
1) Soft-lock (preferred): We can place an internal soft-lock that marks 8 GPUs as reserved for Vertex for a 30-day window starting 2026-12-20. This is a coordination flag — not a contractual hold — and will prevent repurposing without clearing through capacity ops. Requires approval from Capacity Ops (Marissa) and inclusion of a fallback: a quantized 8-GPU compatible variant + 4 spot nodes.
2) Conditional reserve: If they sign a binding Letter of Intent or a small nonrefundable deposit (NFRD) within the next 10 business days we can convert to a committed reserved pool with a 60-day notice cancellation.

Risks: the Dec–Jan holiday cadence may cause some maintenance windows; we should avoid scheduling the POC during known cluster upgrades (Jan 6–8).

If you want the soft-lock, I'll create a capacity ticket and annotate it with the deal_id. I can also attach a brief runbook for fallback scaling paths.

[Attachment: GPU_Runbook_v2.pdf (pdf)]

—Ben
Ben Carter | Capacity Planning Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deal runway clearance / soft lock request — Vertex Analytics (late-stage)

Thanks Ben — that snapshot helps. Priyom, two quick asks before we open the soft-lock ticket: 
- Can we shorten the soft-lock window to 21 days instead of 30 and align conversion criteria to: signed SOW + PO or NFRD? Vertex prefers narrower holds but will accept a clear conversion trigger.
- Please add language to the internal ticket that lists the fallback: (a) quantized model variant (6 GPUs) + (b) spot buffer of 4 GPUs; ops will auto-route to fallback in case of immediate capacity pressure.

Priyom — please confirm if Vertex is willing to accept the 21-day soft-lock with the conversion triggers above. If they agree, Ben, go ahead and create the ticket and mark it "soft-lock:VX-2026-1192". Marissa, please pre-approve the runbook so Ben's ticket can be actioned quickly.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Simon Hale <simon@vertexanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vertexanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deal runway clearance / soft lock request — Vertex Analytics (late-stage)

Hi Priyom / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the sizing assumptions. Vertex is comfortable with the 21-day soft-lock provided the conversion triggers are explicit: signed SOW + PO or a small deposit (we prefer PO). We will prioritize sending the PO to you as soon as legal signs the SOW — target is by the end of next week (12/19).

On the POC start date: we’d like to keep the Jan 10 target but can shift by a week if the maintenance window impacts availability. Please proceed with the soft-lock ticket and share any runbook notes we should be aware of in case we need to flip to the quantized variant mid-POC.

Simon Hale
Head of Platform Engineering
Vertex Analytics
[Attachment: Vertex_POA_estimate_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]
